visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with bleached blonde hair, wearing a suit jacket, white shirt, and striped tie, sits at a desk in a bright office. He is intensely staring at a laptop screen covered in various colorful stickers and starts frantically flipping through a large stack of white papers. (2) The scene shifts to the man on an outdoor balcony, sitting at a desk with a laptop and documents. He looks deeply distressed, resting his head on his hand and rubbing his temple. A smartphone on the desk displays a food delivery app interface. (3) He is seen walking quickly through a modern office workspace while talking animatedly on his smartphone. Other employees are visible at their desks in the background. He exits through a wooden door. (4) Back on the balcony, he is shouting into his phone with wide gestures, looking very agitated. The background shows a city skyline under an overcast sky. (5) He walks through a hallway toward a room, carrying several bright pink paper delivery bags. (6) He enters a room and sits at a wooden table overflowing with food, including multiple pizzas, fried chicken pieces, and several red soda cups. He looks surprised when caught, then smiles and holds up his phone showing a delivery app logo. (7) A digital screen recording sequence shows the user navigating through the foodpanda app, selecting promotions, and entering a specific discount code. (8) The man sits behind the large spread of food, smiling broadly, giving a thumbs-up, and holding his phone to the camera as promotional text overlays appear around him.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main blonde male creator, 2 female office workers in the background, 1 female seen briefly catching the main character.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A male with short, bleached blonde hair. He wears a dark navy blazer, a white dress shirt, and a navy-and-white diagonal striped tie. His pants are dark with vertical pinstripes.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video moves between a professional office with desks, computers, and bookshelves; an outdoor balcony overlooking a dense urban city with apartment buildings; and a neutral indoor room with a large wooden dining table.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Rapid mechanical clicking from keyboard typing is heard, quickly followed by the high-frequency rustling of many paper sheets. No background music is present. (2) A deep vocal sigh and low-pitched mumbling occur as phone keypad tones are played. A standard digital phone ringtone begins. (3) A male voice speaks into a phone with an assertive, professional yet stressed tone. An upbeat, electronic pop BGM with a 128 BPM tempo and strong four-on-the-floor beat fades in. (4) Heavy rhythmic footsteps on a hard surface and the mechanical latch sound of a door opening are heard. The speaker's volume swells as he continues his dialogue. (5) High-arousal shouting from the male speaker: 'Adding pineapple is not pizza, okay?! Get the situation clear!' The tone is aggressive and sharp. (6) More footsteps and the soft crinkling/rustling of plastic and paper bags are heard over the continuous BGM. (7) A female voice yells with a sharp, surprised, and accusing tone: 'You're eating secretly! I'm telling the boss!' (8) The male voice responds with a playful, high-energy defensive tone, explaining he is testing delivery. (9) Extremely fast-paced, high-arousal male narration begins, explaining the foodpanda promotion details. He mentions dates, percentages, and brands with high clarity. (10) Enthusiastic delivery continues regarding the cost savings, ending with a signature catchphrase and a bright, synthesized 'ding' bell sound effect as the music peaks.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Comedic Narrative -> Informative Promotion -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video utilizes a comedic office-themed skit where a character feigns high stress and workload to hide the fact that he is actually ordering a massive amount of food. The primary goal is to promote foodpanda's '65% off' discount campaign and provide the specific promo code '天天省天天爽' to viewers, encouraging them to use the service for food and coffee delivery.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of the foodpanda app, bags, and logo, along with a dedicated segment explaining how to use a coupon code for a discount.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video combines social-media-style humor with clear, instructional promotional content. The high cut frequency and upbeat audio contribute to a high-arousal viewing experience typical of modern short-form advertising.
